review_notes: I read the whole file and compared it with the repo's Tensor/LocalMap/Execution infrastructure. Nothing in Mathlib, Batteries or core corresponds to LocalMap, Execution or the tensor-restriction machinery, so I found no Mathlib duplicate. The one clear competing copy is in-repo: a second, parallel development under `OAI/LinearAlgebra/MatrixFields` (namespace `OAI.MatrixAllFields`) contains textually identical `distributeProduct` and `liftExecution`, and also its own `LocalMap` and `Execution` structures. I confirmed the `distributeProduct` copy and the `LocalMap` copy by reading them. I did not diff `liftExecution` line by line or the full `Execution` structure, and I did not check which of the two developments the rest of the repo depends on. Both copies are imported by other files. `distributeProduct` also repeats the pattern of `replicationProduct`, `flatten` and `unflatten` in FiniteFamily.lean, which are LocalMaps built from a coordinate reindexing. I did not report that as a separate finding, because the case for a shared constructor is a refactor of boilerplate rather than a competing concept. Remaining uncertainty: the MatrixFields development may be a deliberately retained legacy snapshot.

findings.problem: The repository has a second, parallel development of the same all-fields matrix-multiplication construction under `OAI/LinearAlgebra/MatrixFields`. It re-declares `distributeProduct` and `liftExecution` with identical statements and proofs, and also its own `LocalMap` and `Execution` structures with identical fields. The two copies live in different namespaces (`OAI.MatrixAllFields.MatrixMultiplication...` against `OAI.MatrixMultiplication...`), so they are distinct, incompatible declarations. A lemma proved for one `LocalMap` or `Execution` does not apply to the other. Both copies are imported by other files.
findings.proposed_change: Make one development canonical, probably the `MatrixMultiplication` one. Delete the duplicate `MatrixAllFields` block in `HistoryGroupCore.lean`, together with the duplicated `LocalMap`/`Execution` in `MatrixFields/Construction/InitialState.lean`. Then import the canonical declarations in the dependents. If the legacy namespace has to stay for compatibility, expose it as `export` or abbreviations pointing to the canonical declarations, not as re-proved copies.
findings.benefit: One `LocalMap`/`Execution` API removes the duplicated definitions and proofs. Results about extraction histories can be reused across both developments without conversion, and later edits only need to be made once.
